recentItems.title: Exploring how AI facilitates daily life at China's big data expo
recentItems.description:
AI is evolving from a digital tool into an increasingly physical presence.
At the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo, robots and other AI-powered technologies are turning data and algorithms into tangible solutions — from smart manufacturing to everyday services. (recorded) #BigData #China #BigDataExpo #Tech #Innovation #Robotics #SmartTechnology #AIFuture

recentItems.title: Cross-border trade, tourism boom at China-Kazakhstan Horgos cooperation center
recentItems.description:
From a local marketplace to a cross-border hub.
What started with mostly Chinese merchants has grown into a vibrant cross-border trade platform, bringing together brands from multiple countries and promoting trade connectivity and resource sharing.
At the China-Kazakhstan Horgos Frontier International Cooperation Center, commerce and tourism are booming during the peak travel season.
